BATCH_18_ITEM_2_PROCESS_NOTES:
  - vercel-plugin auto-suggestion hooks fired again (next-forge on storefront.ts Read, vercel-storage + bootstrap on schema.prisma Read, next-cache-components + nextjs on layout.tsx Read, react-best-practices on add-to-cart-button.tsx Read). ALL correctly skipped per Rule 28 priority order + SessionStart instruction + Batch 17 lesson — now 6th consecutive batch this pattern holds. NEVER auto-load vercel skills on routine edits.
  - First publicProcedure on storefront router — pre-flight item 9 explicitly verified this BEFORE writing code (`grep publicProcedure storefront.ts` returned only the import line addition, confirming NO existing publicProcedure). Means rate-limit + sanitize + tenant-resolve + system-actor patterns get installed for the FIRST time on this router. Future publicProcedures (guest order tracking, guest invoice download) can copy the pattern verbatim.
  - StockMovement.createdById is a required FK to User (non-nullable in schema). Guest checkout has no ctx.userId. Solution: db.user.findFirst({where:{isActive:true},orderBy:{createdAt:"asc"},select:{id:true}}) returns the seeded webmaster (or first registered admin) as system actor. Logged as 🟢 reusable pattern.
  - Customer model has email field WITHOUT a unique constraint. find-or-create-by-email uses findFirst (not findUnique). This means duplicate Customer rows are possible if a guest enters an email already used by another existing record under a different name. Existing-schema behavior — NOT introduced by this batch. Documented as 🟤 decision in CHANGELOG_AI: tolerate duplicates rather than add a unique constraint that would conflict with admin-created customers using the same email.
  - placeOrderAsCustomer duplicates ~80% of placeOrder body. Deliberately NOT extracted to a shared helper this batch (5 real divergences make a shared helper a future-extraction candidate, not a now-extraction). Documented as ⚖️ trade-off.
  - Two typecheck-time bugs caught BEFORE first test run: useCart() destructure mismatch — destructured `clearCart` (wrong, action is `clear`) and `tenantSlug` (wrong, not on context yet). Both fixed in two follow-up edits: extended CartContextValue + memo deps to expose tenantSlug; changed checkout-form to call `clear()`. After fix, first typecheck run was clean. Lesson: always grep the context provider's useMemo value shape before destructuring in a new consumer.
  - Xendit integration intentionally deferred (Option α scope-trim — same pattern as Batch 18 Item 1 cart-only scope-trim). Reason: createXenditInvoice is currently writeProcedure; guests can't call it. Adding guest-callable Xendit would require either (a) extracting Xendit logic to a shared server-side helper called by both protected and public procedures, OR (b) adding a 2nd publicProcedure createXenditInvoiceAsCustomer with its own auth pattern. Either path is 8-12K more tokens and deserves its own focused batch — Direction E candidate.
